newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - HNC Software started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - HNC Software started as hold.

text.p: - Dain Bosworth Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of HNC Software Inc with a hold rating, due to recent weakness in technology stocks in general and a negative technical trend in the company's shares.
- Dain Bosworth said it estimates HNC earnings for 1997 at $0.50 a share versus $0.31 a share in 1996.
- Dain Bosworth said HNC, a developer and vendor of software applications, has consistently exceeded 40 percent annual growth over the past few years.

"While we believe the company's revenue and earnings growth will slow slightly over the next two years, we have no doubt that the company has excellent business opportunities ahead," the firm said in a statement.
- Shares of HNC Software traded off 7/8 at 24-1/4.
